newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska feedlot cattle market quiet - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska feedlot cattle market quiet - private.

text.p: Nebraska's feedlot cattle market was at a standstill heading into the Memorial Day holiday weekend, market sources said.
Major U.S. beef plants will be closed Monday in observance of the holiday.

Fed cattle on Tuesday were seen priced at $108.00 to $110.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, with packers seen bidding $106.00 to $107.00. The bulk of cattle this week sold at $107.00 to $108.00, although there were sales $109.00 on Tuesday, sources said. This week's sales totaled near 85,000 head, below the estimated showlist of 109,000.
